description: Publish a piece of evidence (a screenshot, a design mockup, an RCA/coverage report) to the portal RIGHT NOW, mid-session, and get back a paste-ready snippet to cite in your ONE resolution comment on the ticket. The file is uploaded, attached to the ticket automatically, and given a tokenized no-login download link — the snippet contains that link (a portal issue gets a markdown link to the file). A report attached to a ticket is numbered and named by the portal (<KEY>_<playbook>_<step>_<NN>), and its snippet leads with a "Report: #NN <link>" line to paste as it is. Use this the moment you have evidence worth showing, instead of waiting for the end of the session (nothing you save after your comment is written can be cited in it). Works on a dispatched job and for every turn of a live app editing session; on a ticketless/chat job it returns a download link only. Files must be ≤ 25 MB and live under your home directory. On any failure the file is left on disk and still uploads at session end, so save deliverables under artifacts/ as a fallback.

caption.description: Optional short label for the snippet. Shown only in the returned snippet as a hint for your comment; it is NOT stored on the artifact.

kind.description: Gallery category. Optional — inferred from the file extension when omitted (images → screenshot, .svg/.html → mock, .pdf/.md/.txt/.csv/.json → report, .mp4/.webm → video).

path.description: Path to the file to publish. A relative path resolves against your workspace (~/workspace); an absolute path is also accepted, as long as it stays within your home directory.

name: publish_artifact
